 for n,s in rows.items():

  pins[n]=s
add(b['anchors'])
while pending:
 n=pending.pop()
 if n in expanded:continue
 expanded.add(n); p=R/n
 assert not any(x.is_symlink() for x in (p,*p.parents)) and sha(p)==pins[n],n
 if n.endswith('.sha256'):
  add(dict(line.split('  ',1)[::-1] for line in p.read_text().splitlines()))
 elif n.endswith('input-binding.json') or '/source-binding-e' in n:
  old=json.loads(p.read_bytes()); add(old.get('files',{})); add(old.get('direct',{}))
  for k in ('anchors','links'):add(old.get(k,{}));pending.extend(old.get(k,{}))

assert len(own)==14 and {str((H/n).relative_to(R)) for n in own}.issubset(c['sources'])

for scope, paths in base['scopes'].items():
 dirs=('src','migrations') if scope=='product' else ('tests',); actual=[]
 for d in dirs:

   if {'__pycache__','.pytest_cache','.ruff_cache'}.intersection(p.parts) or p.suffix=='.pyc':continue
   assert not p.is_symlink()
   if p.is_file():actual.append(p.relative_to(R).as_posix())
 actual+=[n for n in paths if not any('/'+d+'/' in n for d in dirs)]
 assert sorted(actual)==paths,scope
 digest=hashlib.sha256(''.join(pins[n]+'  '+n+'\n' for n in paths).encode()).hexdigest()
 assert digest==base['digests'][scope];inventories[scope]={'count':len(paths),'digest':digest}
der=json.loads((H/'derivation.json').read_bytes());derived={}
for n,row in der['files'].items():
 raw=(R/row['reference']).read_bytes()
 for before,after in row['substitutions']:
  assert before!=after and before.encode() in raw,(n,before)
  raw=raw.replace(before.encode(),after.encode())
 assert raw==(H/n).read_bytes(),n
 derived[n]={'exact':True,'substitutions':len(row['substitutions'])}
feedback=json.loads((H/'main-feedback.json').read_bytes())
assert feedback['actual']['result']['exit_code']==0
f=json.loads(feedback['actual']['result']['output'])
assert f['tests_run']==14 and f['compiled_files']==14 and f['failures']==f['errors']==f['skips']==0
assert f['source_before']==f['source_after'] and f['before']==f['after'] and f['sandboxes_before']==f['sandboxes_after']==[]
tests={}
for n,expected in (('test_core.py',8),('test_runtime_path.py',6)):
 names=sorted(x.name for x in ast.parse((H/n).read_bytes()).body if isinstance(x,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and x.name.startswith('test_'))
 assert len(names)==expected;tests[n]=names
assert sorted(x.removeprefix('::') for x in f['collected'])==sorted(n for names in tests.values() for n in names)
ct=ast.parse((H/'composition.py').read_bytes())
inserts=[x.value for x in ast.walk(ct) if isinstance(x,ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value,str) and x.value.startswith('Path = _r27_path\n')]
assert len(inserts)==1
algorithms={}
for n in ('v2/experiments/action_executor/latency_probe.py','v2/experiments/action_executor/r/run_phase_baseline.py'):
 tree=ast.parse((R/n).read_bytes()); original=ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=True)
 i=next(i for i,x in enumerate(tree.body) if isinstance(x,ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(x.targets[0])=='root')
 additions=ast.parse(inserts[0]).body;tree.body[i:i]=additions
 restored=ast.Module(body=[x for x in tree.body if x not in additions],type_ignores=tree.type_ignores)

 algorithms[n]={'source_sha256':sha(R/n),'original_ast_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest(),'removed_added_storage_and_ready_statements':len(additions),'algorithm_ast_unchanged':True}

import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
prefix=Path("v2/experiments/action_executor/r27/real_path")
archives={
"broker-verify.md.original":"d937cd57b7930b0611feebcf0d41a7e0b884f52b2012366d278d91dc8ff4e0df",

}

for name,digest in archives.items():
 p=root/prefix/"history/previous-publication"/name

 assert actual==digest,(name,actual,digest)
 witness[name]=actual

"vibecode_v2/TIP-054.4b-R27_VERIFY_REPORT.md",
"docs/enterprise-os/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md",
"docs/enterprise-os/TASK_GRAPH.md",

 p=root/name
 body=p.read_text()
 hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 # Only current publication is requalified; dated historical links are preserved.
 if name.endswith("IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md"): body=body.split("R26 and earlier entries")[0]

  path=target.split("#",1)[0]

  checked.append([name,target])
for name in ["main-feedback.json","main-health.json","main-preflight.json","main-structural-check.json"]:
 p=root/prefix/name
 hashes[str(prefix/name)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

assert not owned_caches,owned_caches
